name: Live On The Porch
factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: liveontheporch.com, wlit.fm, greaterlongisland.com.
reviewNotes:
Added for its own event calendar in src/content/sources (PR #8). The dance floor has not been researched yet.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Bing/Google-style places listing matches the address and the Mon-Sat 6 PM-midnight hours; Apple Maps still shows 'Temporarily Closed' (out of date, the venue is open with shows through December 2026). No public phone or email: contact is by web form only (https://liveontheporch.com/contact/), which also handles booking. It is a seated listening room; no dance floor is mentioned anywhere, so dancing is unlikely except standing at shows. Photos skipped: the only large images on the site are an AI-style painted illustration with a generator watermark and a text-heavy 'Opening Spring 2026' promo graphic, not real photos of the room. Logo is the 150 px site icon (largest version on the site).
hours: Mon-Sat 6 PM-midnight on show nights (bar and lobby open at 6 PM unless noted)
description: A 127-seat listening room on the Smithtown Bypass, opened in 2026 by Long Island musician Mike DelGuidice. It books original artists, singer-songwriters, tribute and cover shows and comedy, and has a full bar and small snack menu. General-admission floor seats are first come, first served.

logo.alt: Live On The Porch logo: a painted porch with a guitarist and a dog, and the words Mike DelGuidice's Live On The Porch

evidence.note: Venue's own site: schema data gives 602 Smithtown Bypass, Smithtown NY 11787, Mon-Sat 6 PM to midnight, and links its Facebook and Instagram pages.
Events page says doors and bar open 6 PM unless noted, and general-admission floor seating is first come, first served (guests may need to stand).
WLIT (Aug 2026) describes it as a new 127-seat listening room at 602 Smithtown Bypass focused on original artists, singer-songwriters, comedy and select cover acts.
Greater Long Island (May 2026) reports the 4,000-square-foot venue opened in May 2026.
